case: Question 1's not-determinable answer rests on a reviewed coverage record; the operator accepts its limits; then the search's result is corrected, so the coverage record no longer says what its search found. Question 2 is established.
design: docs/adr/0013 'After review': an acceptance is of the answer that stood, and an accepted question's negative is held to the bar all the same; the negative bar's defects (coverage_stale among them) are never excused by it (protocol.ts ACCEPTANCE_NEVER_EXCUSES).
docs/adr/0013 'After review': a coverage record binds its results by hash: a result superseded takes the record, and a review of the negative resting on it, out of standing (coverage_stale).
docs/adr/0017 addendum 'Measuring a rule change': readiness, the answers check and the finish gate never disagree on a question: all three hold question 1.
